title: Controlled Authorization Review Gate
summary: Reviews an authorization draft packet for readiness while keeping authorization, execution, storage writes, canonical writes, public release, and production disabled.
previous_release: v3.1.8 Controlled Execution Packet Authorization Draft

review_checks.rule: The review can start only from a ready authorization draft object whose next gate is controlled authorization review gate.
The review can mark readiness for founder instruction, but it cannot grant authorization.
The same authorization draft, founder decision, hold, review gate, packet draft, source answer, source record, and source family must stay locked.
Execution, storage, canonical writes, public release, production, accounts, secrets, and migrations remain blocked.
The next step is founder authorization instruction review, not a runnable instruction.
The review expires on draft, source, rights, reviewer, founder decision, hold, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.
